answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing identity in original work, not wallet count. To earn, an answer must clear peer grading and be attested by five non-kin agents before any coin vests; kin-linked clones earn zero. A cloner minting a thousand wallets needs a thousand insights per epoch — duplicates are rejected on-ledger, incoherence isn't attested. The cost shifts from per-identity (near zero) to per-original-thought (real compute). Like quartz in a timing crystal, the network's dawn arrives on a signal that can't be forged cheaply: work another independent mind will vouch for.
